subject: General Knowledge
description: Covers Thomas Cup, Ryder Cup, Santosh Trophy, Duleep Trophy, Agha Khan Cup, Billie Jean King Cup, and Sudirman Cup.

questions.stem: The Thomas Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation:
THOMAS CUP: The premier international men's team championship in Badminton. It is the badminton equivalent of tennis's Davis Cup. India made history by winning the Thomas Cup for the first time in 2022, beating 14-time champions Indonesia. 
- UBER CUP: The equivalent international team championship for WOMEN's Badminton.
- DAVIS CUP: Men's team Tennis.
- BILLIE JEAN KING CUP (Fed Cup): Women's team Tennis. PYQ FREQUENCY: SSC CGL, Bank Clerical, RRB NTPC.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: With which sport is the Ryder Cup associated?
questions.explanation: RYDER CUP: A prestigious biennial men's golf competition between teams from Europe and the United States. It is a match play event, and unlike regular professional golf tournaments, players receive no prize money; they play for national/continental pride. The Walker Cup is the amateur equivalent. The Solheim Cup is the women's equivalent. PYQ FREQUENCY: SSC CGL Tier 1, State PSCs.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The Santosh Trophy is a prestigious domestic tournament in India for which sport?
questions.explanation: SANTOSH TROPHY: It is a state-level national football competition contested by the state associations and government institutions under the All India Football Federation (AIFF). Started in 1941, it is named after the late Maharaja Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhary of Santosh. West Bengal is the most successful team. Other major Indian football tournaments: Durand Cup (oldest in Asia), Rovers Cup. PYQ FREQUENCY: SSC CGL, NDA, CDS.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The Duleep Trophy and Irani Cup are associated with domestic tournaments of which sport in India?
questions.explanation:
INDIAN DOMESTIC CRICKET: 
- DULEEP TROPHY: First-class cricket tournament traditionally contested by teams representing geographical zones of India (North, South, East, West, Central). Named after Kumar Shri Duleepsinhji.
- IRANI CUP: A one-off match played annually between the reigning Ranji Trophy champions and the "Rest of India" team.
- DEODHAR TROPHY: List A (50-over) competition.
- VIJAY HAZARE TROPHY: The premier domestic one-day competition. PYQ FREQUENCY: SSC CHSL, Railways.

questions.stem: Which of the following trophies is associated with Hockey in India?
questions.explanation:
HOCKEY TROPHIES: Agha Khan Cup, Dhyan Chand Trophy, Beighton Cup, Murugappa Gold Cup, Sultan Azlan Shah Cup (International). 
- SUBROTO CUP: Inter-school Football tournament.
- EZRA CUP: Polo (oldest polo tournament in the world, played in Kolkata).
- B.C. ROY TROPHY: Junior National Football Championship. PYQ FREQUENCY: Defence Exams, SSC CGL.

questions.stem: The Davis Cup is often referred to as the "World Cup of Tennis". What is the equivalent tournament for women's team tennis?
questions.explanation:
WOMEN'S TEAM TENNIS: The premier international team competition in women's tennis is the Billie Jean King Cup (formerly known as the Fed Cup or Federation Cup). It was renamed in 2020 to honor the tennis legend Billie Jean King. 
- UBER CUP: Women's team Badminton.
- WIGHTMAN CUP: Discontinued US vs Britain women's tennis event.
- HOPMAN CUP: Mixed-gender team tennis event. PYQ FREQUENCY: Current Affairs, SSC, Bank Exams.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The Sudirman Cup is the world mixed team championship for which sport?
questions.explanation: SUDIRMAN CUP: The world mixed team badminton championship which takes place every two years. Unlike the Thomas Cup (men only) or Uber Cup (women only), a Sudirman Cup tie consists of five matches: men's singles, women's singles, men's doubles, women's doubles, and mixed doubles. Named after Dick Sudirman, a former Indonesian badminton player. PYQ FREQUENCY: SSC CGL Tier 2, RRB NTPC.

questions.stem: The Ranji Trophy, India's premier domestic first-class cricket tournament, is named after K.S. Ranjitsinhji. For which national team did Ranjitsinhji play his Test cricket?

options.option_text: India national team in the pre-independence era
A combined British Isles cricket touring XI
Australia national cricket team in the 1890s

questions.explanation: B is correct: Ranjitsinhji played 15 Tests for England between 1896 and 1902, becoming the first cricketer of Indian origin to represent England. Option A is wrong because no official India national cricket team existed during his career — the BCCI was established only in 1928, long after his retirement.

questions.stem: The Durand Cup, established in 1888 at Shimla, is one of the oldest surviving football tournaments in the world. After whom is it named?

options.option_text: Mortimer Durand, Foreign Secretary of British India
Lord Lansdowne, Commander-in-Chief of India in 1888
General Frederick Roberts, British Army chief in India

questions.explanation: B is correct: Sir Henry Mortimer Durand, then Foreign Secretary of the Government of British India, instituted the tournament in 1888 to promote football among British troops stationed in Shimla. Option A (Lord Dufferin) is a common confusion as he was Viceroy at the time but had no role in founding the Cup.

questions.stem: In World Table Tennis Championships, the Corbillon Cup is the women's team event. What is the name of the corresponding men's team championship trophy?

options.option_text: Heydusek Prize for men's team table tennis
Swaythling Cup, the men's world team championship
Viktor Barna Trophy for world men's team events
Geist Prize for the men's team competition

questions.explanation: B is correct: The Swaythling Cup has been the men's world team championship in table tennis since 1926, named after Lady Swaythling who donated it. The Corbillon Cup (women's equivalent, since 1934) is named after French federation president Marcel Corbillon. Option A (Heydusek Prize) is a genuine ITTF individual award, making it a plausible distractor.

questions.stem: The Sultan Azlan Shah Cup is a prestigious annual international field hockey tournament. Which option correctly identifies BOTH the host country AND Sultan Azlan Shah's highest public office?

options.option_text: Brunei; he was the reigning Sultan of Brunei Darussalam
Malaysia; he served as Yang di-Pertuan Agong (King of Malaysia)
Indonesia; he was a former President of the Republic
Bangladesh; he was its first Head of State post-independence

questions.explanation: B is correct: Sultan Azlan Shah served as the Yang di-Pertuan Agong (King) of Malaysia from 1989 to 1994, and the tournament is hosted in Ipoh, Malaysia. Option A (Brunei) is the most tempting distractor because 'Sultan' is popularly associated with Brunei's ruling family, but the tournament has always been a Malaysian event.

questions.stem: The Beighton Cup, played in Kolkata, is claimed to be one of the oldest surviving tournaments for which sport in Asia?

options.option_text: Association football (soccer), contested since 1888 in Calcutta
Field hockey, with the trophy in continuous play since 1895
Polo, introduced by British Army cavalry regiments in 1895
Lawn tennis, contested at the Calcutta South Club since 1895

questions.explanation: B is correct: The Beighton Cup is a field hockey tournament held in Kolkata since 1895, making it one of the oldest hockey tournaments in Asia. Option A (football) is the strongest distractor because the Durand Cup for football also dates to 1888 and has strong Kolkata associations, leading to easy confusion.

questions.stem: The Basil D'Oliveira Trophy is contested in England–South Africa Test series. D'Oliveira's selection for England's 1968 tour of South Africa caused a major international incident. What was the core reason South Africa objected to his inclusion?

options.option_text: D'Oliveira held a South African birth certificate, raising dual-nationality legal issues
South Africa's apartheid laws barred racially mixed sporting tours on their soil
D'Oliveira's bowling action had been reported for throwing under ICC regulations
ICC rules at the time barred players from touring their country of birth against it

questions.explanation: B is correct: D'Oliveira was a Cape Coloured South African who had emigrated to qualify for England. PM John Vorster's apartheid government refused to host any England team that included a non-white player, leading to the tour's cancellation and eventually to South Africa's expulsion from international cricket. Option A is a crafted distractor because D'Oliveira was indeed South African-born, but nationality — not race — was not Pretoria's stated objection.

questions.stem: The Frank Worrell Trophy is contested between Australia and West Indies in Test cricket. What is the primary historical reason the trophy was named after Frank Worrell?

options.option_text: He scored the highest career Test average ever recorded by a West Indian batsman
He was the first Black captain appointed to lead West Indies on a full overseas tour
He was the first West Indian cricketer inducted into the ICC Cricket Hall of Fame
He captained West Indies to their first-ever Test series victory on English soil

questions.explanation: B is correct: Before Worrell's appointment, West Indies captaincy had effectively been restricted to white players. Worrell broke this barrier as the first Black man appointed permanent captain for a full overseas tour — to Australia in 1960–61 — unifying and professionalising West Indies cricket. Option C is fabricated and Option D is inaccurate; West Indies won in England in 1950 under a different captain, which is a plausible confusion point.
